description: Known production advisories that are tracked and time-boxed. Anything high or critical that is not listed here fails the dependency-audit job. An expired entry fails the job, so it cannot silently outlive its fix.

entries.reason: Uncontrolled memory consumption while validating oversized arrays. Patched in zod >= 4.6.6; the upgrade needs the paired zod-to-openapi bump and is in progress on the S2-01 branch.
